plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Reverted codec fallback order to MP3 → FLAC → AAC. AAC is rejected by Squeezebox Radio hardware firmware. FLAC is more widely supported by both hardware players and squeezelite.
